title: Add sess_reset to provider.h API
description: Add int (*sess_reset)(void *ctx) to crypto2dev_algo_ops in include/crypto2dev_provider.h. NULL means not supported. Contract: re-initialises the session's internal crypto state while preserving the key material. After return, the session is ready for a new write/finalize cycle. IV must be re-set by caller for cipher sessions. Document that providers storing key material for reset must zeroize it in sess_free.
